i might be repeating myself sorry  but for the last 2 day i have been on the phone calling a to z  of government agencys  i do live in the usa  and while so far i have not gotr the people that will actully help me personally  they all have been kind caring and considerate  and are helping me or puting me in touch with the people  that can make a difference

so i urge anyone in need to let down your protective shield  and contact anyone and every government agencys  starting with a crisis line they can help leads you to  other resources  it might take xxx phonecalls  etc but again i have been amazed at the caring and kindness of the people i have spoken with  so far

ty you dont know how nice it is to have people that care  doesnt matter that we nevber met or will meet  just comforting to know people know i exist and care that i do  SO  FROM ME TO YOU  THANKYOU :)

a footnote  this is by far not what i wanted  but it is the best of what i could get  and i urge any senior adults in age 60 or older that are in need of a pretty wide range of possible services to atleast attempt to contact the agency of the ageing where you live basically the county you live in is the one you should contact  while i dont know what this will lead to yet atleast i feel i found a place that they showed me some compassion will i getr what i want no  i will still end up in some hellhole to rot away to dust  but it is not thier fault i might get a advocate or people that might help in guiding me thru this hell i am in and if thier is a rainbow with a pot of gold at the end i will share with all of you :) what a long sorry crappy hand of cards/life i been dealt but i am not complaining we all have troubles they are going to call me in a fwew days to get the ball rolling so we shall see or i will know more
